 Pleasanton Launches a Rainy Season Storm Watch Program

 PLEASANTON — With the rainy season approaching and the potential for significant storms associated with an El Niño winter, the city has launched Storm Watch, a preparedness campaign to help residents and businesses take steps to protect their properties, reduce flood risks and stay informed.
 The campaign is designed to tie together stormwater maintenance efforts, emergency preparedness resources and practical guidelines.
 "Preparing for severe weather is a shared responsibility and making early preparations can make a meaningful difference," said interim City Manager Joe Calabrigo. "City crews are working to prepare critical infrastructure, and we encourage residents and businesses to do their part. Check gutters, downspouts and private drainage facilities to ensure the free flow of water. Take advantage of available resources and stay informed to help keep our community safe."
 The city is also cleaning storm drains, clearing debris and maintaining public drainage infrastructure to reduce the risk of localized flooding.
 Through the Storm Watch program, the city is also encouraging community members to take advantage of the following resources and preparedness measures:
 • During the rainy season, free sandbags will be available at a self-service facility at 3333 Busch Rd. There is a limit of 10 sandbags per business or household.
 • Standing water and drainage issues can be reported online through the city's MainStar service request system. Emergencies or immediate threats to safety can also be reported by calling 911.
 • Help prevent flooding by putting leaves and yard waste in green organic carts, rather than leaving them in the street.
 • Sign up for Alameda County's AC Alert program to receive emergency notifications, including severe weather warnings, flood information and evacuation orders.
 Pleasanton said Storm Watch will continue to provide preparedness tips and storm-related information through the city's website, Facebook and Instagram channels, and electronic newsletter.
